title: All-team decision backlog and cascade canvas (Q3 prep)
summary: Working doc to consolidate decisions, prioritization tradeoffs, and the town/cascade agenda for the Q3 planning window. Purpose: shorten the alignment loop between exec, product areas, and SRE so engineering teams get deterministic signals by sprint+2. This is intentionally a lightweight canvas + decision backlog (not the final OKR doc).
objectives: Define top 3 company-level objectives for Q3 with measurable success criteria
Capture carry-forward commitments vs new bets and flag required capacity
Agree on rollout/fallback policy for high-risk initiatives (especially Private and Dedicated launches)
Create a clear cascade and comms plan for all-hands + follow-up team rituals
success_criteria: OKR owners named and committed by 2025-05-16
>80% of cross-team dependencies triaged into Linear by 2025-05-23
Canary/fallback playbooks drafted for any customer-impacting rollout before QA sign-off
agenda: Executive sync (20m): top-line Q3 framing + 3 asks to org
Decision canvas walkthrough (25m): annotate backlog and gating criteria
Breakouts by quadrant (30m): product, infra, platform, growth — surface risked items
Convene & commit (20m): name owners, set deadlines, capture blockers
decision_backlog: Dedicated capacity SLA bump: decision needed on 99th p99 SLA target vs cost bracket A/B
Private onboarding easing: postpone on-prem GA to Q4 unless top 5 pilot customers sign MSA by 2025-06-15
Batching defaults for hosted API: adopt adaptive batching v1 for cost savings but provide per-route opt-out
Model catalog pruning: retire <2% usage model variants unless active experiments exist — owners to identify exceptions
open_questions: What is the acceptable latency uplift for quantization profiles on Dedicated? (SRE + Serving to answer)
If we delay on-prem GA, what concessions on support will Sales need for enterprise pilots?
Do we need a temporary pricing floor to prevent tail-end usage spikes during rollout?
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Late infra capacity causing launch slip — Mitigation: reserve burst pool for two launches in Q3
Risk: OKR ambiguity between Hosted API and Dedicated ownership — Mitigation: create a single cross-functional epic with clear handoff checklist
Risk: Eval regressions after model swaps — Mitigation: gate model promotion with a canary and automated eval set
timeline: May 2025: finalize company-level OKRs -> Mid-May: teams declare work and blockers -> Late May: comms plan + all-hands dry run -> June sprint planning: lock rollouts and safety playbooks
asks_from_executive_team: We need two decisions from Execs by 2025-05-15: (1) whether to prioritize Dedicated SLA improvements over Private GA, and (2) approve 10% temporary budget reserve for burst capacity. Also ask: execs to nominate one exec sponsor per top-level objective.
communication_plan: All-hands (June week 1): 30m exec highlights, 20m product demos, 30m team breakouts
Follow-up: team-level cascade emails with explicit blockers and Linear links within 48 hours
Ops: update status board with a single column for 'exec-decisions'
breakout_guidance: Each breakout must produce: 1) top 3 risks, 2) named owner for mitigation, 3) linear ticket ids for blockers
Use template: Problem -> Impact -> Proposed decision -> SLO/metric to watch
notes_to_owners: This doc is the canonical decision backlog for the Q3 cascade — owners please add single-line updates under your item and link Linear tickets. If you need more runway, mark item 'carry-forward' and propose a concrete milestone.
owner_notes: Drafted after SLT offsite. Expect iteration — I'll fold in feedback from product reviews. Priority: get exec decisions on SLA vs Private by 5/15. Miguel owning the all-hands rundown, Renee owns comms. Samir to coordinate SRE capacity numbers.
